title: Nicht schlecht
desc: Praise arriving at a size you did not expect
setting: A Sunday table in Kriens, five people, and the first thing you have ever cooked for them.

options.feedback: Not wrong. It also stops the exchange one step early, and there was a step left.

options.es: Es ist ein bisschen zu salzig.
options.en: It is a bit too salty.
options.feedback: Make it smaller and let him make it bigger again. That is the dance and he knows the steps.
That is the top of his scale. Asking for more turns the best thing he says into a disappointment.
The list, and the modesty in front of it. Both are expected and neither is a lie.

options.es: Ein altes Rezept von meiner Grossmutter.
options.en: An old recipe of my grandmother's.
options.feedback: A story where a list was asked for. She will ask again in a minute.
A joke that reads as a wall. She asked because she wants to make it.

steps.speaker: Reto
steps.en: Can you do that again some time?

options.feedback: Yes, and a mal in the middle so it is not a commitment with a date on it.

options.es: Wenn ihr wollt, mache ich das jeden Sonntag.
options.en: If you like, I will do it every Sunday.
options.feedback: Far too much, and it puts them under an obligation they did not ask for.
Modesty is right, and he asked a question. Answer it as well.

steps.speaker: Kurt
steps.es: Du kochst besser als der Reto.

options.en: That is not a high bar.
options.feedback: Teasing back, at the person who is in the room, once. Reto will laugh and take more.

options.en: Thank you, that really pleases me.
options.feedback: Accepting it flat, in front of the person it was measured against.
Deflection is right and this one contradicts him instead of moving past it.
